Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A general knowledge quiz show approached a line cook and a lawyer about being contestants. Both had to take a test beforehand to see if they should be on the show. The line cook got nearly every answer wrong and was excluded because they wouldn't be a good contestant, but the lawyer scored well and was selected. Who is intelligent?
A. Not enough information
B. The line cook
C. The lawyer
